scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm -w backend run dev" "npm -w frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w backend run build && npm -w frontend run build
scripts.test: npm -w backend run test && npm -w frontend run test
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && sleep 4 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
